fact: SARB Directive No. 1 of 2025 directs settlement participants to move low-value cross-border EFTs within the Common Monetary Area from SADC-RTGS to the TCIB payment scheme, ceasing SADC-RTGS use by 31 March 2027 and using TCIB from 1 April 2027.
title: South African Reserve Bank Act: Directive No. 1 of 2025 - Directive in respect of the execution of low-value cross-border electronic funds transfers within the Common Monetary Area
publisher: South African Reserve Bank (Government Gazette No. 52435)
